blocks.text: This page tracks the Whistler MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $1,350,700 for a typical home, little changed at −0.9% over twelve months.
Whistler benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Whistler home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,350,700 in September 2026. That is up 2.5% on the month, little changed at +1.3% over three months, little changed at +0.4% over six months and little changed at −0.9% over the year. Over three years it is down 5.3%, and over five years little changed at +0.4%.
The weakest one-year move in Whistler was for an apartment homes at −5.3%; the strongest was a townhouse at +1.8%.
The gap between a detached home ($2,553,100) and an apartment ($601,400) is $1,951,700, and a townhouse ($1,695,400) sits $1,094,000 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Whistler is 25.5% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against little changed at −0.9% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Whistler ranks 3 by all-home benchmark, with Bowen Island above it at $1,405,400 and North Vancouver below it at $1,290,400.

Detached homes in Whistler: benchmark $2,553,100, up 2.5% in a month, down 3.8% in three months, down 6.8% in six months, little changed at −0.7% in a year, little changed at −1.1% in three years and up 3.7% in five. That is 43.1% above the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Whistler: benchmark $1,695,400, little changed at +0.3% in a month, little changed at +0.3% in three months, up 4.5% in six months, up 1.8% in a year, up 1.7% in three years and up 16.8% in five. That is 66.8% above the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Whistler: benchmark $601,400, up 5.0% in a month, up 6.0% in three months, little changed at −0.4% in six months, down 5.3% in a year, down 15.9% in three years and little changed at −1.4% in five. That is 11.9% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: The $1,350,700 Whistler figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Whistler?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Whistler home was $1,350,700, with detached at $2,553,100.

faq.q: Are Whistler home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Whistler is little changed at −0.9% over twelve months and little changed at +1.3% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
